listing.name: Donkey Kong Bananza / DKB Recomp (Lucas-blip-png)
listing.summary: Static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) to native Windows and Linux with Vulkan. 0.5.2 out: TOTK to DKB rename, Feast Layer muck fix, 4 GB cards, Switch 2 controllers on USB; one-file Windows launcher. Requirements: docs/requirements.md. Roadmap: #10. No game files included.
